EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.title: Urda, Loamweaver
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_URDA.epithet: The roots beneath the floor remember your passage.
EZMB_URDA.title: Urda, Loamweaver
EZMB_URDA.epithet: The roots beneath the floor remember your passage.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.description: Urda stirs beneath the earth and four blessings pulse from its bark.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_see: A blessing linked to combat card rewards. Some rewards will ask for your seed.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_hum: A blessing linked to combat card rewards. Compost a reward to gain Gold and feed a later payoff.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_mol: A blessing that changes what returns to your hand at the end of your growth.
EZMB_URDA.pages.INITIAL.options.urda_mos: A blessing that rewards room progression through hidden fungal routes.
EZMB_URDA.pages.DONE.description: Urda's blessing sinks into the soil. The chosen path is set.
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.title: Morvi, the Lender-Scribe
EZMICROBALANCE-EZMB_MORVI.epithet: Every favor arrives with a margin note.
EZMB_MORVI.title: Morvi, the Lender-Scribe
EZMB_MORVI.epithet: Every favor arrives with a margin note.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.description: Morvi opens a ledger and offers three ways to borrow power.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_m: The first Attack or Skill you play each combat is replayed once. Powers are never replayed.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_o: Normal Act 2 combat card rewards upgrade one Attack or Skill option.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.INITIAL.options.morvi_d: Gain 75 Gold. Normal Act 2 combat card rewards can be skipped to repay 25 Gold, or nonlethal HP if you are short. After 3 payments, gain an upgraded card reward.
EZMB_MORVI.pages.DONE.description: Morvi closes the ledger. The debt is written.
